caves.name: Whispering Hollow
caves.needs_text: It's very dark inside. A Bright Lantern would light the way.

1.text: A stone door. Four cold braziers wait in this room.

2.text: A heavy gate. Two pressure plates in the room seem connected to it.

3.text: A shortcut gate. It only opens from the other side.

hints: Each brazier has little dots painted on its stone. Maybe they count something.
Light them in the order of their dots: one dot first, then two, three and four.
Start with the top-right brazier (one dot), then bottom-right, top-left, and bottom-left.
The gate opens when both pressure plates are pressed down. The stone blocks look heavy but slide easily.
Stand behind a block and press E to push it away from you, one step at a time.
Push the upper block three steps east, and the lower block six steps west. The lever puts them back if they get stuck.
There's no bridge... or is there? Something faint shimmers over the chasm.
The pedestal looks made for a lantern. A Bright Lantern might show what is hidden.

caves.name: Singing Grotto
caves.needs_text: Echoes drift from the dark. A Bright Lantern would light the way.

T.text: A door of sleeping crystal. It hums very quietly, waiting for the right note.

5.text: A crystal seal. A beam of light could wake it.

hints: The light wants to reach the glowing crystal in the far corner. Each standing crystal turns with E.
The beam should turn downward at the third crystal along its way, then turn toward the target.
Both crystals in the third column should lean like this: \  The lever starts over.
This beam starts low on the left and wants to reach the top-right crystal.
It climbs like a staircase: up, right, up, right.
The four crystals on the staircase all lean like this: /  The lever starts over.
